+| Publication | PUBLISHED / UNPUBLISHED | Exact report publication pointer and matching READY decision plus unchanged market evidence gate |
+| Analysis | READY / PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE | Publication/completeness, not natural-language sentiment |
+| Recommendation | QUALIFIED / BLOCKED / NO_QUALIFIED_OPPORTUNITY | Independent company/Premium evidence; a no-qualified result needs complete real universe assessment |
+| Confidence | AVAILABLE with a finite 0–100 value / UNAVAILABLE with null | A valid published decision's actual value; QA completeness is not investment confidence |
+| Closing | NOT_DUE / PENDING / COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / NOT_APPLICABLE | Same-date, same-published-decision closing evidence; elapsed time alone cannot complete it |
+`READY + PUBLISHED` displays the current official market judgment.
+`PARTIAL + UNPUBLISHED` displays **今日分析尚未完成／證據不足** and preserves
+the current candidate's true date; it is not FAILED, INVALIDATED, a completed
+closing, or a reason to substitute yesterday's holiday report.
+Market READY with recommendation BLOCKED remains a readable market report,
+with **推薦評估證據不足，今日暫不發布正式個股推薦** in the stock area. No
+stock or Opportunity Score is generated by the subscriber renderer. Existing
+server-side entitlement is a separate, necessary access boundary.
+Missing/blank/nonfinite confidence, insufficient analysis and unpublished QA
+always produce unavailable confidence, never 100 or a quality-score fallback.
+A real finite zero remains zero. Legacy STOP, confidence=100, completed
+checkpoints and closing aliases must not revive a rejected state projection.
+Closing COMPLETE additionally requires an explicitly complete, non-degraded
+receipt bound to the published opening decision, valid same-day verification
+time, actual TAIEX/2330/TXF changes and no missing-data entries. Raw snapshot
+capture, a fetched 14:30 bucket, a legacy close review, or an expired clock
+window cannot substitute for that proof. NOT_DUE has no completed outcome.
+Non-trading nodes retain NOT_APPLICABLE rather than pending/upcoming trading.
+The server sanitizes old subscriber aliases as well as exposing the new wire
+state. Authenticated admin diagnostics stay under `admin_source_report`, not
+the nested AI object consumed by subscriber pages. No Auth, role, RLS, ACL,
+publication producer or notification behavior changes are implied.
+History summaries use the same publication pointer, READY status and market
+evidence boundary before exposing confidence or a decision sentence. One
+bounded revision lookup covers the requested history; a missing/unpublished
+revision stays incomplete at its real date, never a QA 100/100 summary.
+When closing is not COMPLETE, the server also removes completed 14:30 and
+lifecycle aliases consumed by an older cached frontend. Other genuine market
+checkpoints remain intact for an already published market report.
+Permanent regression includes the shared schema, actual Payload projections,
+legacy alias poisoning, frontend lifecycle/closing/confidence, and the real
+Auth/PKCE and actual HTTP payloads; synthetic fixture writes are scope-guarded
+and restored exactly. It is not Production evidence. Any future release must
+check the exact Backend/Frontend pair and old-reader compatibility before
+deployment, not just individual JS/CSS HTTP success.
